scope: Synthetic in-memory ZIP/XML and temporary fixture directories only. No real workbook, existing scientific cache or network.

invariants.name: opaque_component_noninterference
invariants.method: Construct independent minimal XLSX envelopes. Change worksheet/shared-string/comment payload canaries and unknown sheet names while preserving approved roles; require equal approved semantic output and no leaked text. Whole-object identity differences are excluded explicitly.

invariants.name: decompression_allowlist
invariants.method: Instrument ZIP entry reads on synthetic buffers; fail if any worksheet/shared-string/other unapproved content is opened or decompressed, even when it is malformed XML.

invariants.name: safe_internal_graph
invariants.method: Challenge canonical paths, duplicate members/relationship IDs/sheet names, external/traversal relationships, unresolved or mismatched targets; constant bounded failures must omit canaries.

invariants.name: bounded_parser
invariants.method: Challenge exact-limit/over-limit member count, decompression output, XML depth and prohibited DTD/entity/profile constructs with small synthetic artifacts; no bomb allocations.

invariants.name: fixed_redirect_route
invariants.method: Use an injected synthetic transport if available; require one approved HTTPS host/path redirect only, query kept out of receipts/errors, disallow second redirect and source mismatch without real requests.

invariants.name: production_guard_precedes_effects
invariants.method: Invoke ignored-candidate/invalid inventory/cache/receipt paths using fake side-effect counters; source mismatch, symlinks or collisions must prevent network and output mutation.

evidence_policy: Execute only after candidate API is available; retain actual command stdout/stderr/exit and bind reviewed source/test hashes before and after. Failed tests remain recorded. Author source is never modified by this reviewer.
